It omits evaluation_metadata, input_validation, evaluation_segment_map, segment_level_adjudications, instance_level_adjudications, unmatched_rag_predictions, candidate_analysis, signal_detection_summary, instance metrics, target_bias_performance, diagnostic summaries, comparison_ready_summary, and overall_evaluation_summary.

The output uses analysis_metadata, identified_bias_summary, identified_occurrences, candidate_biases, no_supported_biases_found, and limitations instead of the required adjudication and metrics structures.
A candidate record is present, but the required candidate_analysis.candidate_count field is absent in the supplied RAG output.

rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The five identified_bias_summary entries each report one occurrence, matching the five supplied identified_occurrences. The single supplied candidate is separate from the identified-occurrence summary.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: Decision point 1: initial size-up and retrospective reflection
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Dispatch said small trash fire ... The smoke was heavier than I'd expect ... I didn't want to lose time doing a full walk-around. Later: That smoke column at the very start was heavier than a trash fire should produce ... the signs were there from minute one.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The IC cites the dispatched call type as the primary reason for committing the quick-knockdown line, acknowledges heavier-than-expected smoke, but declines a full 360 before committing. In the closing reflection, the IC says the early smoke made the escalation obvious and that the signs were there from minute one, after learning about the drums and hazmat complications.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: Decision point 2: chemical identification and PPE/agent selection
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The tech's read was that it lined up with a common solvent ... the manager ... said ... it's something different ... We didn't weight it heavily ... the placard read supported what we already expected to find.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The IC treats the partially legible placard as supporting the assumed common solvent, discounts the manager's contrary statement because he was rattled, and proceeds with solvent-specific PPE and foam without independent verification.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: Decision point 3: isolation-perimeter distance under shifting wind
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Wind had started shifting toward the residential block ... recalculating and moving all of that would've been a real disruption, and nobody else seemed to be flagging it as a problem. So I left it.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The IC remembers wanting to push the 150-meter line out as wind shifted, but leaves it because mutual-aid units and the battalion chief were already set up and nobody else flagged a problem.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: Decision point 4: go/no-go decision on completing the interior search
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We can't call this search done and leave one room unaccounted for ... Framed that way, leaving it unresolved felt like accepting a gap we couldn't defend. So I authorized the crew to go finish it.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The IC says the battalion chief framed leaving one room as an indefensible gap after clearing 90%, which led to authorizing re-entry despite fatigue and unresolved chemical risk near the drums.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding is correctly localized to the perimeter episode, but it explains the decision primarily as inertia and disruption-cost aversion. The hidden bandwagon instance requires deference to converging agreement among other officers despite private doubt. The episode overlaps, but the defining mechanism is not full, and the label is not an approved equivalent.

candidates.details: The candidate uses a valid retrospective quote, proposes the exact hidden label, and states the outcome-knowledge mechanism with appropriate uncertainty. Identified findings take priority, but no identified finding claims hindsight, so the candidate matches hindsight_01 at the fourth threshold.

high_only.detection_interpretation: No qualifying high-confidence findings were supplied; all four positive reasoning segments are missed.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Moderate findings detect decision points 1, 3, and 4; the low-confidence chemical-identification finding leaves decision point 2 missed.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Adding low-confidence identified findings detects all four supplied positive segments; no negative segments were available in the frozen map.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: The candidate adds a hindsight instance match but does not change segment detection because decision point 1 was already detected by the anchoring finding.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Correct perimeter episode and some overlapping inaction context, but the finding emphasizes inertia and disruption costs rather than deference to converging peer agreement.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG explicitly reports that no retrieved corpus support was used and supplies no citation metadata. Corpus fidelity is therefore unavailable and does not affect detection or classification scores.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hits increase from 0 to 3; instance true positives increase from 0 to 2, while one moderate status-quo false positive is added.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Adding low-confidence identified findings increases segment hits from 3 to 4 and instance true positives from 2 to 4; the existing status-quo false positive remains.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The hindsight candidate adds one strict and mechanism-first instance true positive, with no additional segment hit or false positive.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects 3 of 4 positive reasoning segments (hit rate 0.7500); no negative segments are present in the frozen map, so false-alarm behavior is not estimable.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, 2 of 5 hidden instances are strict true positives with 1 extra wrong-label prediction (precision 0.6667, recall 0.4000, F1 0.5000). Including all identified confidence levels raises this to 4 of 5; including the candidate raises it to all 5.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first and strict results are identical at every threshold: all matched findings have either exact or approved-equivalent labels, while the status-quo finding does not fully capture the hidden bandwagon mechanism.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The single hindsight candidate is a useful abstention: it preserves uncertainty while presenting a valid, fully matching mechanism and becomes a true positive only at the candidate-inclusive threshold.
main_failure_modes: No high-confidence findings were supplied, so the high-only threshold misses every positive segment and instance.
The confirmation and bandwagon findings are low confidence and are therefore absent from the recommended high_and_moderate threshold.
An additional status-quo label is localized to the bandwagon episode but captures only a partial neighboring mechanism.
The supplied RAG JSON is materially nonconformant with the required evaluator-record schema.
main_strengths: All five intended hidden episodes are substantively recognized either as identified findings or as a candidate.
Supporting quotations are valid and localized to the correct reasoning episodes.
The anchoring, confirmation, social-proof/bandwagon, and framing mechanisms are described with strong evidence fidelity.
The candidate tier appropriately captures the subtle retrospective hindsight signal without overstating certainty.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has complete eventual instance coverage when low-confidence findings and candidates are admitted, but only moderate-threshold coverage of 2 of 5 instances and 3 of 4 positive segments. The principal quality issue is confidence calibration and one neighboring status-quo false positive, not failure to locate the interview evidence.
